# Accepted capabilities

### capability-java-shelf-assignment
## Java shelf assignment

Checks a box assignment against a depot, shelf capacity and duplicate assignment state, then stores the assignment and publishes an event in a receipt.

- [claim-java-assignment](claims/p-1a25b331742a-001.md#claim-claim-java-assignment)

- [claim-java-memory-adapters](claims/p-1a25b331742a-001.md#claim-claim-java-memory-adapters)
